summary: The Instagram APK is the Android installer for Instagram, Meta's photo and video app for posts, Reels, Stories and direct messages. Google Play updated it on November 24, 2026, and the version varies by device. It's free to download, shows ads, and is for users aged 13 and up.
metaDescription: Instagram APK download for Android: get the official Instagram from Google Play, with install steps, teen safety settings and fixes when it stops working.

faq.q: How do I download the Instagram APK safely?
faq.a: Install Instagram from Google Play, where the developer is Instagram. Meta doesn't publish its own Instagram APK, so copies on other sites aren't official and can steal your login.

Instagram's minimum age is 13. Accounts for under-16s are Teen Accounts by default: private, with limits on who can message them and stricter content settings. Parents can use Supervision in the Family Center.

Usually it's the connection, an outdated app, a full cache, or a Meta outage. Update Instagram from Google Play, clear its cache in Android Settings → Apps → Instagram → Storage, and restart your phone.

faq.q: Why is Instagram asking for my ID?
faq.a: Instagram may ask you to confirm your age or identity, for example if it thinks you're under 13, if your account was flagged, or to recover a locked account. Only do this inside the Instagram app, never through a link in a message.

faq.q: Can I use Instagram on PC?
faq.a: Yes. Use instagram.com in any browser to browse, post and message. Windows also has an Instagram app in the Microsoft Store.
